questionText: Which of the following is a primary responsibility of a tester in a CI/CD pipeline?
options: Manually executing all regression test cases before every code commit to the repository
Identifying which tests should be automated and integrated into the build process for rapid feedback
Being the sole owner of product quality and deciding alone when a build is ready for production.
Postponing all non-functional testing until the final delivery stage to avoid slowing down the pipeline
correctAnswer: Identifying which tests should be automated and integrated into the build process for rapid feedback
explanation: Refer 2.1 Phần CI/CD trong Devops là nói về test automation, và phản hồi sớm
